notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Note #1 – Demo Update 🛠️
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone!

Since the demo launched during Steam Next Fest, we’ve made a few updates — and we’ve just pushed out another one right now! This is our [b]first official patch note[/b], and it covers all the changes from the last small update.[/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has tried the demo and shared feedback — it’s been super helpful. Here’s what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a visual bug when entering a vehicle while the storage UI was open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could press phone buttons without holding the phone.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved some collider issues on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed phone camera rendering issues on [b]Low[/b] graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed misaligned POS device buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Pop-up screens can no longer be dragged unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor bugs were cleaned up.
[/p][/*][/list][p]💪 [b]Gameplay & Systems[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]stamina system[/b] has been improved — a new [b]fatigue mechanic[/b] has been added to make stamina usage more meaningful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Object throwing has been temporarily disabled.[/b]
Accidental drops were leading to failed missions. We're working on a more reliable system for item handling and delivery damage, and we’ll reintroduce throwing once it's ready.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all the support — keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates! 💚[/p][p]– The Delivery Guy Team 🚴‍♂️📦[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Our Demo is Now Live on Next Fest! 🚨
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381900/8419e35e7834ccfb0808141ceaf5a7d61ca0f045.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the first playable version of our demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]This is our very first playable demo, so bugs and performance issues will most likely appear. If you notice anything odd, feel free to share it in the community or our discord server — we’d really appreciate it and it helps us a lot![/p][p][/p][p]We’re planning to keep updating and improving the demo all the way until the game’s full release — this version is just the starting point.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo includes 2 in-game days, offering around 20 minutes of core food delivery gameplay. Right now, only the main delivery loop is active.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot for being here with us and supporting the project — your feedback means the world to us![/p]
